render_camera_path_video: render a camera path from a JSON file into an MP4 video using the camera-path subcommand
render_interpolated_trajectory: render a trajectory that interpolates between training or eval dataset camera poses using the interpolate subcommand
render_spiral_trajectory: render a spiral camera trajectory around the scene using the spiral subcommand
render_circle_trajectory: render a circular camera trajectory around a specified center point using the circle subcommand
render_dataset_images: render all images in a dataset split and save outputs as images or video using the dataset subcommand
